lss.summary: One 72 s cycle: 56.3% of the time the operator is visible is value-adding. The 18 s wait for a part is the largest waste and the whole overrun against the 60 s takt; two safety rules were broken (hard hat at 00:16, running at 01:06) and a deep bend to the far bin was flagged.

lss_cards.title: Stop the 18 s starve at the fixture: balance the feed to takt
lss_cards.observation: The operator stood idle for 18 s (00:34-00:52) with an empty conveyor. That wait alone puts the 72 s cycle 12 s over the 60 s takt.

evidence.note: idle, no part at the fixture

lss_cards.root_cause: The upstream station delivers late, so the operator is starved by the line rather than slow.
lss_cards.recommendation: Draw a Yamazumi chart for the two stations, move work from the upstream bottleneck to the one that waits, and add a kanban trigger so a part is staged two cycles before the conveyor runs empty.

lss_cards.title: Bring bin B into the normal working area
lss_cards.observation: The operator leans and reaches across the bench to the far bin once per cycle (00:14-00:18, about 4 s).
lss_cards.root_cause: Bin B sits outside forearm reach, on a stand to the right of the bench.
lss_cards.recommendation: Move bin B within forearm reach in the order of use, at elbow height, with a gravity-feed bin so the part is presented at the fixture.

lss_cards.title: Standardize the post-cycle walk-out
lss_cards.observation: The operator walks off at the end of the clip (01:04-01:11), including a run at 01:06-01:09.
lss_cards.root_cause: The reason for leaving is not visible: it may be material delivery or a break.
lss_cards.recommendation: Confirm with the operator why they left, then stage the missing item at the line side so the walk is not needed.

safety_actions.action: Remind the operator at the shift-start check and keep spare hard hats at the cell entrance; use the camera alert as a reminder, not for discipline.
Find why the operator ran (a late part, a far andon call) and remove that reason; mark the walkway.
Raise bin B to between knee and shoulder height so the reach no longer needs a deep bend.

operator_questions.question: I saw an 18-second pause at 00:34. Were you waiting for a part from the upstream station?
At 00:16 your hard hat was off. Did you take it off to reach bin B?
You left the cell at 01:04. Were you going to fetch something?
